{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Confirm premises
assert 'paid_search' in sales['channel'].unique(), "Channel 'paid_search' not found"
assert 'new' in sales['customer_segment'].unique(), "Customer segment 'new' not found"

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f"Found {qa_mask.sum()} QA orders. Removing them.")

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {sales_clean['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum()}")

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered = sales_clean[
    (sales_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new')
]

# Compute conversion fraction
n_total = len(filtered)
n_converted = filtered['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = n_converted / n_total if n_total > 0 else 0

# Print results
print(f"Total NEW paid_search customers: {n_total}")
print(f"Converted: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")"}
